scopeAndLimitations: This review evaluates the accepted run 43450247714 at exact source 8020e5c3243cd99e6f727e787c3109bece3d28f7 and build 39a9a382cb37a4fb. Earlier diagnostics or failed release runs are not substituted for these measurements.

The artifact ZIP was downloaded once by the isolated extraction workflow, which verified its API digest and bytes. This reviewer fetched one completed compact extraction log and independently verified all 45 text chunks, length and SHA256 before recomputation; no binary artifact was downloaded by this reviewer.
No acceptance scenario, browser measurement or workflow was rerun for this review. Original budgets, native gestures and reporting windows remain unchanged.

The complete audit objects are retained in the referenced raw evidence blob. This review preserves all 32 independently derived summaries, measurement boundaries, slow intervals and native pan witnesses.
The original full build-log request returned Transport closed without bytes and was not repeated. The transport failure cause is not established.
This review did not independently decode screenshots or inspect the APK; native pixel and Android producer validation are separate evidence.
Android-portrait here is a Chromium emulated touch profile with physicalDevice:false. CPU1 means no synthetic slowdown, not a physical Android device measurement.
Input-to-next-frame is the next rendering opportunity and the observed EventTiming sample is not field INP or proof of presented pixels.
Early and full browser environments match by the original comparator. These are not randomized paired measurements against earlier sources; no percentage speedup or causal attribution is inferred.

The earlier 3cb full desktop pan failure at 35.10000000009313 ms and instrumented CPU traces remain separate historical evidence; their original failure status and instrumentation limitations are preserved.
